messages:
deploy-bot: Manual approval required to continue deployment to PRODUCTION
service: redwood-inference-api
env: production
tag: v2.14.0-rc5
commit: abc1234def (SHA)
change window: 2026-03-21 01:00-02:00 UTC
reason: perf/quant fixes, small model kernel tweak
required approvers: @maya @josh
rollback plan: pin back to v2.14.0-rc4, immediate rollback on sustained 5xx spike
Approve: respond with /approve or react with :white_check_mark: — deploy link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/ops/1835123456

maya: Quick q — does this include any CPU-side tokenization changes or only GPU quant kernels? If tokenization changed we need to run compatibility checks with legacy clients.

josh: Only GPU-side quant path and a small kernel reorder. No tokenization changes. I ran the end-to-end test suite against rc5 and saw no breakages locally. Will hold approval until SRE smoke is green.

li: Oncall here — starting smoke in az-a now, will validate traces and error budgets (5–10m). Also will ensure alert thresholds are enabled for the new latency variance.

amanda: From PM: feature owners ok with canary, but request 30m observation if we see p95 variance. Canary can be 10% for 15m as standard, but we should be ready to extend.

li: Smoke finished — no obvious errors. p50/p95 +1%/+3% respectively. No 5xx. Kicking off 10% canary for 15m now.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout -> production (10%)
service: redwood-inference-api
tag: v2.14.0-rc5
commit: abc1234def
initiated_by: li
command: ```/deploy rollout --service redwood-inference-api --tag v2.14.0-rc5 --canary 10% --duration 15m```

josh: /approve :white_check_mark:  — watched unit tests and perf locally, good to go if canary is clean.

maya: /approve :white_check_mark:  — approving but please hold full 100% until Amanda confirms release notes updated.

amanda: Adding release note blurb now: "Reduce per-token inference cost by ~4% via quant kernel reorder; no API changes."

deploy-bot: Canary complete (15m). Metrics summary: p95 latency +2.8%, error rate 0.03% (baseline 0.02%). No sustained spikes. Proceeding to 100% rollout now. :rocket:

sre-oncall: Observed a transient spike at +2m into canary (0.6% 5xx for 1m) that auto-resolved. Watching for recurrence over next 30m. If it comes back we'll trigger immediate rollback to v2.14.0-rc4. :eyes:

li: Noted. I'll keep dashboard pinned and run a focused tail of 5xx logs and traces for 30m.

amanda: Thanks team — tagging release notes and changelog. If no issues in 30m consider this release green. :tada:

deploy-bot: Full rollout finished — 100% production traffic now on v2.14.0-rc5. Approval recorded: maya, josh. Rollback policy remains active.
